title: feat(examples): starter app — companies and contacts, with the platform's tasks and notes in the menu
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgHVbWpCRuUVdAwYZM7iAyUy)_
Fixes #36944

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 新增一个起步应用：菜单里有「公司」「联系人」，以及平台自带的「任务」「备忘」，附看板、公司页里的联系人列表、样例数据和一个概览仪表盘，中英文都有。
- 属于「起步应用与平台任务/备忘」专题，给新环境和开发者一个开箱可用、装上就能改的模版。
- 出错只影响装了这个模版的组织；卸载它会删掉公司和联系人，任务和备忘不受影响，可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

New private example package `@objectstack/example-starter` in `examples/app-starter`, written from metadata alone (no hook, function or plugin):

- **Objects** — `starter_company` (name, type, industry, website, phone, address, description; the platform's `owner_id`) and `starter_contact` (name, company lookup, job title, influence, email, phone, notes). A contact is an external person; the platform's people objects are not reused. The `starter_` namespace keeps both clear of a CRM package's own account/contact names, so a tenant can install both.
- **Views** — for each object a grid (`all`) and a kanban (`by_type` on company type, `by_influence` on contact influence). The create and edit form is each object's `fieldGroups` (a declared default `form` is not loaded by the Console since the form-view change, lint `form-view-internal-not-loaded`). The company record page lists its contacts (`relatedLists`).
- **Menu** — four object entries: `starter_company`, `starter_contact`, `sys_task`, `sys_note`, plus the overview dashboard. No entry carries a label, so each shows the localized label of what it opens (the platform already translates `sys_task`/`sys_note` to 任务/备忘). Tasks and notes are the platform objects; the package declares no copy.
- **Data and dashboard** — five sample companies, six sample contacts (create-only seeds), two datasets and one overview dashboard (`Dashboard.create`, ADR-0059 §1 factory form).
- **i18n** — en and zh-CN bundle (公司 / 联系人, options, field groups, list views, dashboard widgets).
- **Install modes** — `installModes: ['managed', 'unmanaged']`: the unmanaged copy is the starter path (the organization takes the app over); `managed` stays permitted because an install that names no mode is managed, and a walled deployment refuses unmanaged.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` gains the importer; `.changeset/36944-app-starter.md` is a patch on the private package.
- `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` gains one line, `"examples/app-starter/objectstack.config.ts": 0` (written by the gate's own `--update`, a one-line diff): a new config must be baselined, and this one declares no untranslated string. Outside the card's declared file surface; added with the zone's approval.

## Tests

`examples/app-starter/test/boot.test.ts` boots a host that brings nothing of its own, with the marketplace install door mounted, then over HTTP:

1. installs the starter as an unmanaged copy with sample data (`POST /marketplace/install-local`, `installMode: 'unmanaged'`, `seedSampleData: true`) and reads 5 companies and 6 contacts, a contact's lookup resolving to its company;
2. reads `GET /meta/app/starter_app` and finds the four object entries in order: `starter_company`, `starter_contact`, `sys_task`, `sys_note`;
3. writes a task and a note through `/data/sys_task` and `/data/sys_note`;
4. uninstalls the copy (`DELETE /packages/com.example.starter-copy`): 200, then `starter_company`, `starter_contact` and `starter_app` answer 404;
5. reads the task and the note back by id: both still 200.

The install body is the build-shaped artifact (the normalized stack, JSON round-tripped); the starter has no callable for the build's lowering to bind.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

Head `e391123a` (the last commit only adds the baseline line below; package code unchanged since `8e0de7bb`).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-starter validate` — exit 0, `Validation passed`, 2 objects / 14 fields / 1 app / 2 views / 1 dashboard.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-starter typecheck` — exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, `test/**` included).
- `os lint --i18n-strict` in `examples/app-starter` — exit 0, `All checks passed`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-starter exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (under `os-verify-lock`) at `8e0de7bb` — `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 5 passed (5)`.
- Ablation at `8e0de7bb`: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` of the `nav_notes` entry (anchor 1 to 0, blob `767c9f15e9b6` to `f6021a9ed9eb`) — the menu test fails (`Tests 1 failed, 4 passed (5)`); restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 74 families on the final change set; all 74 run, each exit 0 (`check:i18n-coverage` re-run at `e391123a`: `OK (15 config(s), 577 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`). `dispatch-gates --ran`: `74 derived, 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- Every CI family is read from this PR's check runs, not re-run locally.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Card item 7 (`is_starter`) carries nothing in this repo.** `TemplateManifest.isStarter` is a retired key (migration entry `18.marketplace__TemplateManifest__isStarter`: the starter flag is a platform decision honoured only on a first-party seed), no workflow here publishes `examples/app-*` to the marketplace, and `os package publish` never sent the manifest's flag. What this repo carries is the package itself and its `installModes`; promoting it to a starter is the cloud half (cloud#4957).
- **The menu entries for `sys_task`/`sys_note` carry `requiresObject`.** Without it `defineStack` (so `os validate` and `os build`) refuses the package: `App 'starter_app' navigation references object 'sys_task' which is not defined in objects.` Every other cross-reference check in `stack.zod.ts` exempts platform-prefixed objects (`isPlatformObjectName`); the navigation check does not, while `sys-task.object.ts` documents a plain `type: 'object'` entry naming `sys_task` as the way an app lists tasks. Filed #37404; `requiresObject` is the authored route available today and hides the entry only where the object is absent, which `sys_task`/`sys_note` never are.
- The contact board groups on `influence`: a field named `role` is refused by `security-role-word` (ADR-0090 D3).
- HotCRM's API names were not read (outside this repository's scope); the `starter_` prefix is distinct from every `account`/`contact`/`crm_*` spelling.
- Prior rulings read: ADR-0022 §5, ADR-0032 §2–§5, ADR-0059 §1/§5, ADR-0062 D2/D8, ADR-0076 D4–D8 — no conflict (factories used for every domain, CEL-free metadata, no datasource declared, no `onEnable`).

## Verification

First files to read, by risk:

1. `examples/app-starter/src/apps/starter.app.ts` — the four menu entries, `requiresObject` on the platform two.
2. `examples/app-starter/test/boot.test.ts` — install, menu, uninstall, survivors.
3. `examples/app-starter/objectstack.config.ts` — manifest, `installModes`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-starter test` — expect `Tests 5 passed (5)`.
